National Council of Insurance Legislators (NCOIL)
Synthetic Remote Lamplighting Model Act
(invented for tests; not an NCOIL text)
*Adopted by an invented committee on April 4, 2026.
*Sponsored by an invented legislator

AN ACT concerning lamps lit from a distance by authorized lamplighters using
communication technology.

(A) As used in this section:
"Remote lamplighter" means a lamplighter who lights a lamp from a distance.
(B) A remote lamplighter shall keep a record of each lamp lit.
Note: An invented note on records.
(C) This section applies to lamps lit after its effective date.
